claims.text: Fine-grained entity typing involves assigning multiple semantic types to entity mentions, rather than a single type.
The task of fine-grained entity typing is approached as a multi-label classification problem, where each entity can have multiple types assigned from a fine-grained type set.
Recent approaches to fine-grained entity typing utilize richer ontologies for semantic types, moving beyond standard coarse types.
